Name: Hilkiah, Father of Azariah
Summary: Father of Azariah the ruler of the house of God, son of Meshullam son of Zadok.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:11: Father of Azariah the ruler of the house of God, son of Meshullam son of Zadok.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hilkiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
